description:
Birds in a church of Sikijor island, Philippines. (Binaural)
I recorded this binaural audio file in a church in Sikijor island (Philippines), while birds were flying and screaming from left to right and from right to left over my head .  
In the background, you can hear sounds from outside.
Recorded in January 2018, with an Olympus LS-3 and an Ohrwurm 3D binaural microphone. 
Fade in/out and high pass filter 60Hz -6dB/oct applied in Audacity.
name: LS_33885_PH_BirdsInChurch.wav
